title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function $$f(x)=|x|$$ might affect the relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$. What kind of transformation does the absolute value function perform?

title: Effect of Absolute Value
text: What happens to the values of $$x$$ when you apply the absolute value function?

title: Model Fit with Absolute Value
text: Consider how the transformation by $$f(x)=|x|$$ might help in fitting the model $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$ to the data. Does the pattern of the data suggest that this transformation could be useful?
